reasons.action: The caller explicitly asks for a performed behavior — to say the line again word for word — so the speaking/vocal action is request-governed rather than derived from any plate.
reasons.medium: The medium decision already fixes the rendering medium as having no reference authority; no visual medium reference was supplied, so the medium stays request-governed.
reasons.wardrobe: No visual reference exists and no clothing is observed, so wardrobe is governed by the request alone.
reasons.lighting: No visual reference supplies lighting, and the audio clip governs only voice timbre and delivery, so lighting is request-governed.
reasons.framing: No visual reference supplies a composition or shot scale, so camera framing is request-governed.
reasons.palette: No visual reference supplies color or tonal grading, so palette is request-governed.
